title: Alice Scully says photos of the Aztec crash still exist

tellings.quote: she told him that there were definitely photos of the Aztec crash still in existence.

plain: A researcher named Scott Ramsay, speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast, talks about a craft said to have crashed near Aztec, New Mexico, in 1948. He says a woman named Alice Scully told a man named Chris Evans that photos of the Aztec crash definitely still exist. If true, there could be pictures of a crashed craft out there.
